state_contract: Host config and catalog_path; pause, identity, receipt and source-hash protections unchanged
import_side_effects: No new service/browser/model starts; capabilities preserve their original explicit call side effects
compatibility: New projects use canonical packages and public APIs; existing resident entries are served only by pipeline adapters

web_card_service__owner_enabled.description: Keep the single driver while any independently authorized web lane runs.

web_card_structure_repair__authorized_ar.description: Only the exact immutable old receipts bound by this single-use grant.

web_card_delivery_repair__authorized_arc.description: An archived completed delivery failure has one bound human authorization.

web_card_inputs__digest.description: Streaming SHA-256; rejects file stat changes during reading.

web_card_retry__finished_response.description: Only a persisted complete response bound to actual sent material qualifies.

paper_quality__validate.description: Accept the webpage's overall score; never recompute dimension totals.

web_card_service__publish_saved.description: Unified live source identity guard, human protection, staged metadata, SQLite writer transaction/CAS and durable publication intent. Legacy structures explicitly remain legacy_valid; scientific verification is separate.

web_card_json__normalize_escapes.description: Only escape syntactically invalid JSON backslashes; retain scientific text.

web_card_service__code_version.description: Owner-startup source fingerprint. module_sha256 now also carries dependency:web_gpt.core, dependency:web_gpt.package, dependency:web_gpt.zip_uploads, dependency:codex_desktop_chat.bundles and dependency:playwright.sdk, so external drift changes the fingerprint the acceptance checker compares.

web_card_retry__run_once.signature: run_once(config, *, pages=None, entries=None, router=None, clock=time.time, page_guard=None, checkpoint=None, monotonic=time.monotonic)
web_card_retry__run_once.description: Called by the exclusive keeper; never sends, switches providers or unpauses.

web_card_service__external_dependencies.description: Fingerprint the outside web_gpt kernel, its ZIP adapter, the shared packer and the Playwright SDK from the registered implementation path; status is incomplete when registration, a file, the SDK version or the actually loaded module disagrees.

web_card_inputs__visual_budget.description: 新材料24MB软目标与48MB硬预算；软目标只降整页视觉至150DPI，仍超硬限继续原DPI步骤，保留原文/卡片图像/全部页。返回accepted及真实目标是否达到；冻结材料不调整。

seed_trials__run_once.description: Explicit current manual-root three-generation campaign. Preserves old cards/receipts, true scores and retry/pause/unknown guards; uses existing material worker only.

seed_trials__record_review.description: Explicit current manual-root three-generation campaign. Preserves old cards/receipts, true scores and retry/pause/unknown guards; uses existing material worker only.

seed_trials__status.description: Read-only three-candidate progress and original review scores. Never counts queued requests as generated cards.

seed_trials__check_request.description: Read-only final original-owner check of root/human protection, fixed authorization, source and independent request identity before attachment/send. No browser or queue mutation.

web_card_inputs__parse_card.description: Strict existing card schema/parser; independent production acceptance reuses this exact implementation, scientific content is never inferred.

web_card_retry__cooperative_digest.description: Hash every byte with bounded owner-loop checkpoints; detect file changes; no browser connection or mutation.

side_effects: 本地材料/队列/候选与卡片发布；实际上传和发送交给browser唯一所有者。
selection_and_retention: 当前生产仅使用GPT网页版。单ZIP、材料哈希、通用评分与完整回执防止附件混淆和旧答案污染；结构完成不冒充科学通过。专项修复代码仍核对已用次数，保留它们用于阻止重发。
runtime_activation: No automatic start/resume; existing controls and sole owner remain authoritative

card_contract.activation: newly prepared packets only; immutable old packets remain legacy_valid
card_contract.publication_identity: job/packet/current catalog/current file SHA-256 must agree; identity/version/scope and human guards apply
card_contract.publication_commit: staged materials and metadata fingerprints + immutable rework version + BEGIN IMMEDIATE/CAS + durable intent; proven complete files can reconcile local registration without resubmission

recent_recovery_contract.response_wrapper: Single complete explicitly JSON-marked object; raw prefix delivery failures remain blocking; duplicate keys/scientific contracts unchanged

new_visual_transfer_policy.formula_json: formula-json-v2 new inputs only, existing scientific/control-character rejection unchanged

selection_projection.scope: acquisition=available and non-null asset path; original later guards preserved
selection_projection.columns: identity/path/decision/card path plus ranking and protection metadata only
selection_projection.citation_count: missing falls back to cited_by_count; explicit null remains null

manual_seed_priority_contract: Registered manual root seeds rank first in every runnable stage, including preparation, cross-lane admission, correction successors, retry/recovery scans. Stable original FIFO/score within groups; no preemption, deadline bypass, pause override, extra retry or unknown resend. core.api.workflow_priority__seed_first preserves original recovery record objects.

manual_seed_three_candidates.scope: explicit five-root source-hash list and authorization SHA
manual_seed_three_candidates.selection: highest real full-source passing review >=85, no missing/major/critical or unapplied correction; otherwise existing repair
manual_seed_three_candidates.preservation: original cards/reports/receipts/retry counts, pauses and unknowns; no old answers in generation
manual_seed_three_candidates.progress: cards.seed_trials.status; independent priority label, never sentinel numeric quality

independent_source_request.effect: neutral unique ID in new source context and actual prompt; hashes/ZIP distinguish separately authorized generations; never changes frozen existing inputs or exempts prior upload intent

manual_seed_technical_retry.eligibility: Registered manual_seed_roots input_hash equals job source_sha256; all current receipts explicitly not_sent/deferred with send_click_started=false; full existing source/input/history/page/pause/quota and CAS guards
manual_seed_technical_retry.counter: technical_retries; external_retries retained unchanged; legacy structure cap unchanged
manual_seed_technical_retry.backoff: configured base (default 300 seconds) times 1, 3, then 12, without further growth
manual_seed_technical_retry.archive: history/seed-technical-retry-<count>-<nonce>; original bytes captured before archive; no model request is sent by run_once
manual_seed_technical_retry.unknown: Submitted, unknown and completed-response structure failures never gain this exception
